title: Street
wikitext:
A '''street''' is an area that connects all of the [[location]]s in a [[neighborhood]]. Streets allow [[investigator]]s to move from one area to another. [[Encounter]]s can sometimes take place in streets (for example - with creatures from the [[sky]]), or an investigator can be moved to the street after finishing an encounter in a different area.

[[Investigators]] with a [[Sheldon Gang Membership]] may use their special ability while in the street, as well as have an [[Exhibit Encounter]] if they end in a street with the [[Ancient Whispers marker]]. [[Ithaqua]]'s Icy Winds ability will trigger if he is the [[Ancient One]], and will cause an investigator to lose one [[Stamina]] if he ends his turn in the street.
